status: re-declared by the pull request that closes #692 before any statistic, for the re-run of the screen on the Fed repo take-up columns as #659 corrected them (Eleonora, 13 October 2026). It is the declaration of #629 unchanged (leads, targets, series list, clustering, bootstrap, incremental step) except for the panel's pin: the scratch panel is re-built on the current tree, so its sha256 is 6a1085f1… where #629's was 8299bac3…. Exploration on development data, not a record; nothing is published.

panel.built_by: docs/pivot/source-matrix-ordinary-days-result.md (Reproduce): source_screen.py panel over the published panel's scratch panels and satiation_distance_598.py's

days: the scored days of the lead-1 fold grid, 2018-06-29 to 2025-12-31 (source_screen), the same days at every lead
ordinary_days: a scored day whose day type (metadata/evaluation_splits.json) is ordinary and whose treasury_settlement_coupons, dated from the auction announcement (#541) and read at lead 1, is not positive: the risk-date rule of the every-day part (announcement_dating_rescore.risk_flag)

target_definitions.pressure: the spread strictly above +5 bp on whole basis points (repo_model.data.exceeds_bp)
target_definitions.level: the spread of the scored day
target_definitions.change: the spread of the scored day less that of the day before

series.rule: every column of the joined scratch panel (except date, sofr and iorb) that the as-of rule reads, as published; the spread's own as-of lag; the columns the settlement dating (#541) or the per-release H.4.1 dating changes, read a second time as NAME@per_release; and the 14 inputs of the every-day part (#601), formed from the per-release masked frames

subsets: ordinary days by as-of scarcity state (ample | scarce | unknown)
matrix.statistic: Spearman on the days both series are present; a pair with fewer than 30 days is left empty

cluster.linkage: complete: every pair in a group has |rho| >= the threshold; a missing correlation never joins
cluster.matrix: ordinary days, pooled, lead 1 (the all-days matrix is clustered too, as a check)
cluster.representative: the member with the largest mean |rho| to the other members (the medoid), chosen without the target

target_screen.spearman: each series with each target at each lead, pooled, by period regime and by as-of scarcity state (at the same lead); empty under 30 days or 3 pressure days
target_screen.auroc: pressure days against the other ordinary days, per lead and split, with a 90% bootstrap interval
target_screen.pre_onset: onsets (repo_model.pressure.onsets) that fall on ordinary days; the pre-onset days are the 1 to 5 panel days before each, scored and ordinary; the contrast is their series, read at lead 1, against the other ordinary days: standardised difference and AUROC, each with a 90% bootstrap interval; empty under 3 onsets or 10 pre-onset days in a split

bootstrap.resampling: the stationary bootstrap over the days of the split in date order (repo_model.metrics.stationary_bootstrap_indices), one draw per replication shared by every series; the interval is the 5th and 95th percentile

incremental.series: the 15 series with the largest absolute pooled ordinary-day Spearman with the pressure indicator over leads 1 to 10, the two controls and the spread's own lag left out
incremental.controls: the as-of scarcity state and the tail spread (sofr_p99_iorb_bps), each read at the lead of the cell
incremental.statistic: the rank correlation of the series and the target after the ranks of the controls are regressed out of both, on ordinary days

regimes: period slices of metadata/evaluation_splits.json (fixed in advance) and the as-of reserve-scarcity state; no regime is drawn from the outcome
due_diligence: one table per source from metadata/sources.json and metadata/sources_measurement.json: publisher, start of history and gaps measured on the panel, frequency, the publication instant the as-of rule uses, vintages, caveats citing findings
tests_counted: the report states the number of correlations, AUROCs and contrasts computed and that none is corrected for multiplicity
published: nothing; no variant, input or setting joins any published declaration
